sa: एवं ब्रुवन्तं राजानं निशायां जीवलोऽब्रवीत्। कामेनां शोचसे नित्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि बाहुक॥
en: Jivala asked the king, while he was muttering the above verse in the night, saying: 'O Bahuka! I desire to learn about the person, for whom do you mourn every day.

sa: सा कन्दुकेनारमतास्य मूले विभज्यमाना फलिता लतेव। गात्रैच गात्राणि निषेवमाणा समाश्लिषच्चासकृदृष्यशृङ्गम्॥
en: She played before him with a ball like a broken creeper bent with fruits. She touched his body with her own and she again and again clasped Rishyashringa with her arins.

sa: ब्रह्मचारी वदान्यो योऽधीयीत् द्विजपुङ्गवः॥ स्वाध्यायवानमत्तो वै तं देवा ब्राह्मणं विदुः।
en: Who that foremost of the Brahmanas, is a Brahmachari, possessed of liberality and always attends to the studies, who carefully studies (the Vedas). The gods know him to be a Brahmana.

sa: कथं तु जातसंकल्प: स्त्रियमुत्सृजते पुमान्। परार्थमीदृशं वक्तुं तत् क्षमन्तु महेश्वरराः॥
en: "O gods, pardon me; and how it is that a person, who is in the same way determined (to get Damayanti), can dare speak to the damsel on behalf of others."

sa: तामवेक्ष्य ततः क्रुद्धः समपध्यायत द्विजः। भृशं क्रोधाभिभूतेन बलाका सा निरीक्षिता॥
en: Thereupon the twice-born one, who was greatly chraged, beholding the female crane, intended to do her an injury. The crane was looked by him, when he became insensible with great rage.

sa: ततः स पीत्वामृतकल्पमम्भो भूयो बभूवोत्तमवीर्यतेजसाः। उत्पाट्य जग्राह च सोऽम्बुजानि सौगन्धिकान्युत्तमगन्धवन्ति॥
en: When he drank the water (of the lake) which was like ambrosia, his energy and strength were again fully restored; he then plucked and gathered the golden lotuses of excellent fragrance.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राज्ञः सेनाचयायिनः। सरो द्वैतवनं गत्वा गन्धर्वानिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: Those warriors, who forned the vanguard of the Kuru army, having heard those words of the king, went back to the lake of the Dvaitavana and thus spoke to the Gandharvas.

sa: अक्षांश्च दृष्ट्वा शकुनेर्यथावत् कामानुकूलानयुजो युजश्च। शक्यो नियन्तुमभविष्यदात्मा मन्युस्तु हन्यात् पुरुषस्यधैर्यम्॥
en: Seeing the dice obedient to the wishes of Shakuni in Ayuja and Yuja (odds and evens), I could have controlled my mind, but anger (you know) drives off a person's patience.

sa: अकीर्तिः कीर्त्यते लोके यस्य भूतस्य कस्यचित्। स पतत्यधमाँल्लोकान् यावच्छब्दः प्रकीर्त्यते॥
en: The man, the report of whose evil deeds is talked about, is said to fall down; and he lives in the lower region as long as that evil report lasts. me

sa: श्रूयते हि महाराज सरो द्वैतवनं प्रति। वसन्तः पाण्डवाः सार्धं ब्राह्मणैर्वनवासिभिः॥
en: O great king, we have heard that they are now living on the banks of the lake situated in the forest named Dvaitavana with many Brahmanas, the dwellers of the wood.

sa: कुबेरसचिवाश्चान्ये सैद्रा मैत्राश्च राक्षसाः। तैः समेष्याम कौन्तेय संयतो विक्रमेण च॥
en: O son of Kunti, here are the ministers of Kubera and his other friends who are all fearful Rakshashas. We shall have to meet them therefore gather up all your prowess.

sa: युक्तमेतत् तृतीयायां प्रकृतौ वर्तता त्वया। वक्तुं धर्मादपेतार्थं त्वं हि सर्वकुरूत्तमः॥
en: You are the foremost of the Purus-living as you do in the third state (celibacy), it is but fit that you should give such advice, which is so void of morality.

sa: महेन्द्रो नाम कौरव्य भार्गवस्य महात्मनः। अयजत् तत्र कौन्तेय पूर्वमेव पितामहः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, there is also the hill called Mahendra, sacred to the high-souled descendant of Bhrigu (Rama), where in the days of yore the Grandsire (Brahma) performed his sacrifices.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच बहु वित्तं पराजैषीर्धातूंश्च सहयद्विपान्। आचक्ष्व वित्तं कौन्तेय यदि तेऽस्त्यपराजितम्॥
en: Shakuni said O son of Kunti, you have lost much wealth, heroes and elephants with your brothers. Tell us if you have anything else which you have not as yet lost.

sa: गुणांस्तस्य स्मरन्त्या मे तत्पराया दिवानिशम्। हृदयं दीर्यत इदं शोकात् प्रियविनाकृतम्॥
en: Remembering his virtues day and night, my mind is always directed towards him; and my heart is about to burst in grief on account of the absence of that beloved one.

sa: शौचं तु यावत् कुरुते भाजनस्य कुटुम्बिनी। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन् क्षुधासम्पीडितो भृशम्॥
en: While the matron was cleansing the vessel for giving the alms, then, her husband entered the house all of a sudden. O foremost of the Bharata race, oppressed with great hunger.

sa: आगमिष्यति ते भ्राता कृतास्त्रः क्षिप्रमर्जुनः। सुरकार्यं महत् कृत्वा यदशक्यं दिवौकसाम्॥
en: Your brother will soon came back to you after having obtained all weapons and after having accomplished a great deed for the celestials which is incapable of being done by them.

sa: तत्र चेद् युध्यमानानामजिह्ममनिवर्तिनाम्। सर्वशो हि वधः श्रेयान् प्रेत्य लोकान् लभेमहि॥
en: If we all die in a fair fight without turning our backs on our foes, even that would be better than this exile, for we shall then obtain regions of bliss.

sa: जन्तुर्येष्ठः समभवज्जनित्र्यामेव पार्थिव। स तासामिष्ट एवासीन्न तथा ते निजाः सुताः॥
en: O king, Jantu became the eldest son and he was born to his former mother. He became the most beloved of all those women but not so were their own sons.

sa: अवाप्य नारीरत्नं तु पुण्यश्लोकोऽपि पार्थिवः॥ रेमे सह तया राजञ्छच्येव बलवृत्रहा।
en: O king, that righteous prince, having obtained a maiden like a gem, began to enjoy her sweet company, even as the slayer of Bala and Vritra enjoys the company of Sachi.

sa: को हि मां भीमसेनाद्य क्षितावर्हति पार्थिवः। क्षेप्तुं कालपरीतात्मा यथैष कुलपांसनः॥
en: O Bhimasena, what king was there on earth who could abuse me as this wretch of his race, who has been already taken for his own by Death, has done today.

sa: ते तु तत् सर्वमखिलमाख्यायास्मै यथातथम्। नापश्यंस्तमृषिं तत्र गतासुं ते समागताः॥
en: The chiefs, then having truly related to him all that had taken place and having returned to the place (where the corpse of the Rishi was) did not find it there.

sa: अङ्कयामास वत्सांश्च जज्ञे चोपसृतांस्त्वपि। बालवत्साश्च या गावः कालयामास ता अपि॥
en: He caused the calves to be marked and took notes of those that required to be tamed. He also counted all those cows of which calves had not yet been yeaned.

sa: अपि चेदं वयस्तुल्यं बाहुकस्य नलस्य च। नायं नलो महावीर्यस्तद्धिद्यश्च भविष्यति॥
en: Again, both Nala and Bahuka seem to be of the same age. This person may not be identical with Nala of great energy; but he must be somebody of equal knowledge.

sa: आख्यास्ये ते प्रियं तात महत् पाण्डवनन्दन। ऋषिभिः सहितो राजन् कृष्णया चैव तच्छृणु॥ यत् त्वयोक्तो महाबाहुरस्त्रार्थं भरतर्षभ। तदस्त्रमाप्तं पार्थेन रुद्रादप्रतिमं विभो॥
en: O child, O descendant of Pandu, O king, I shall tell you something which will give you great pleasure. Listen to it with Krishna (Draupadi) and with the Rishis that are with you. O lord, O best of the Bharata race, Partha has obtained from Rudra that matchless weapon for which you had sent that mighty armed hero to the celestials region.

sa: अलं स तेषां सर्वेषामिति मेधीयते मतिः। नास्ति त्वतिकृतार्थानां रणेऽरीणां प्रतिक्रिया॥
en: In my opinion he alone is equal to them all; it is impossible otherwise to vanquish in battle all those foes who have all attained great success in all those purposes.

sa: द्वाभ्यां भुझाभ्यामाकाशं बहुशो निजधान ह। क्रीडन् भाति महासेनस्त्रील्लोकान् वदनैः पिबन्॥
en: Striking the air with two hands and playing about on the hill-top, the mighty Mahasena of matchless prowess looked as if he were on the point of devouring the three worlds.

sa: रत्या मत्या च गत्या च ययाहमभिसन्धिता। जीवितप्रियतां मह्यं धिमां संक्लेशभागिनीम्॥
en: Madri looked upon me as her stay and her mind and her affections were ever fixed on me. Fie on my desire of life? I suffer all this woe for it.

sa: शत्रवस्तव राजेन्द्र न चिरं शोककर्शिताः। सा तु बुद्धिबलेनेयं राज्ञस्तस्माद् युधिष्ठिरात्॥
en: O king of kings, that which you saw not long ago with so much grief has been now snatched by you from the king Yudhishthira by the force of intellect alone.

sa: तथैव यः क्षमाकाले क्षत्रियो नोपशाम्यति। अप्रियः सर्वभूतानां सोऽमुत्रेह च नश्यति॥
en: So that Kshatriya too becomes unpopular with all and meets with destruction both in this world and in the next, whose anger is not appeased when the time for forgiveness comes.

sa: ते हि सर्वे नरव्याघ्राः शूरा विक्रान्तयोधिनः। सर्वे नागायुतप्राणा वज्रसंहनना दृढाः॥
en: All these foremost of men (the Pandavas) are heroes of great prowess in war. They are endued with strength of ten thousand elephants; their bodies are as hard as the thunder.

sa: स पूज्यमानस्त्रिदशैर्महात्मा गन्धर्वतूर्येषु नदत्सु सर्वशः। दिव्यैश्च पुष्पैरवकीर्यमाणो महार्णवं नि:सलिलं चकार॥
en: Being thus worshipped by the celestials while the musical instruments of the Gandharvas played all around and celestials blossoms were showered on him, that highsouled (Rishi) made the great ocean waterless.

sa: एषधाता विधाता च संहर्ता चैव शाश्वतः। श्रीवत्सवक्षा गोविन्दः प्रजापतिपतिः प्रभुः॥
en: He is Dhata, Vidhata, the destroyer of all, the Eternal, the hearer of Srivatsa mark on his breast, he is Govinda, the lord of all creatures, the highest of the high.

sa: दस्यूनामिव यद् वृत्तं सभायां कुरुनन्दन। तेन न भ्राजसे राजस्तापसानां समागमे॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O king, as these wrongs have been perpetrated in your Sabha, wrongs that are like the acts of thieves, you cannot shine in the assembly of ascetics.

sa: षष्ठं छागमयं वक्त्रं स्कन्दस्यैवेति विद्धि तत्। घशिरोऽभ्यन्तरं राजन् नित्यं मातृगणार्चितम्॥
en: Know that the sixth face of Skanda was that of a goat. That face, O king, is situated in the middle of the sixth. It is always adored by the mothers.

sa: समरे प्रद्रुतौ तौ तु वृषभाक्षौ तरस्विनौ। अन्योन्यं जनतुर्वीरौ पङ्कस्थौ महिषाविव॥
en: Rushing at each other in that fight, those two heroes, having eyes like those of bulls and gifted with great activity, struck each other fiercely like two buffaloes in the mire.

sa: तस्माद् धर्मेण योद्धव्यमिति स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्॥ सत्सु नित्यः सतां धर्मस्तमास्थाय न नाशयेत्।
en: Manu himself, the son of the Self-create (Brahman), has said that battles should be fought fairly. The righteous should always treat the righteous fairly. They should follow righteousness without destroying it.

sa: मुहूर्तमपि राजेन्द्र तिन्दुकालातवज्ज्वलेत्। न तुषाग्निरिवानर्चिधूमायेत चिरं नरः॥ नानार्थिकोऽर्थसम्बन्धं कृतघ्नेन समाचरेत्।
en: It is better, O monarch, that a king should burn up for the time being like charcoal of ebony-wood than that he should smoulder and sinoke like chaff for many years.

sa: यस्तु कर्ताऽस्य वैरस्य निकृत्या निकृतिप्रियः। सोऽयं विनिहतः शेते पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते॥
en: He, who was the root of these hostilities, and who fomented them by means of his wiliness, that wretched being, lies struck down, on the bare ground, O lord of Earth.

sa: तथापि लोके कर्माणि समावर्तन्ति भारत। शुभाशुभफलं चैते प्राप्नुवन्तीति मे मतिः॥
en: I think, O Bharata, that acts, good and bad, are perpetually revolving here as on a wheel, and men reap the fruits of those acts, good or bad, that they do.

sa: सम्भृत्य महतीं सेनां चतुरङ्गां युधिष्ठिर। साम्नैव वर्तयेः पूर्वं प्रयतेथास्ततो युधि॥
en: Even after enlisting a large army consisting of the fourfold forces, you should, O Yudhishthira, first behave peacefully. If your attempts to secure peace fail, then you may engaged in battle.

sa: गहनं भवतो राज्यमन्धकारं तमोऽन्वितम्। नेह विश्वसितुं शक्यं भवतापि कुतो मया॥
en: Good and evil are seen here in the same light. To live here is not, therefore, safe. Here a righteous person meets with death, while an unrighteous man incurs no danger.

sa: सर्वान् देवान् नमस्यन्ति सर्वधर्मांश्च शृण्वते। ये श्रद्दधानाः शान्ताश्च दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, who bow to all the gods, who listen to the doctrines of all creeds, who have faith, and who are possessed of tranquil souls, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: एकसार्थप्रयातानां सर्वेषां तत्र गामिनाम्। यस्य कालः प्रयात्यग्रे तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: All creatures are like members of the same caravan bound for one destination. What is there to be sorry for if Time meets with one a little earlier than with another.

sa: इत्युक्तो भगवान् देवः स्मयन्निव निरीक्ष्य ताम्। उवाच नियमं ज्ञात्वा सांत्वयन्निव भारत॥ उग्रं तपश्चरसि वै विदिता मेऽसि सुव्रते। यदर्थमयमारम्भस्तव कल्याणि हृद्गतः॥
en: Thus addressed by her, the illustrious god, smiling as he looked at her and knowing her observances, addressed her sweetly, saying "Your practices of penances is known to me, O you of excellent vows, the object cherished in your heart, for which you have been trying your best, O auspicious one, shall, be accomplished. Everything attained by penances. Everything depends on penances.

sa: आचार्यशापोऽनुगतो ध्रुवं त्वां यदग्रसच्चक्रमिदं धरित्री। ततः शरेणापहृतं शिरस्ते धनंजयेनाहवशोभिना युधि॥
en: Even now she exclaims-Forsooth your preceptors' curse has followed you. When the wheel of your car was sunk in the Earth, the cruel Dhananjaya cut off your head with a shaft.

sa: सदैव याचमानेषु तथा दम्भान्वितेषु च। एतेषु दक्षिणा दत्ता दावाग्नाविव दुर्हतम्॥
en: If a gift is made to one who always accepts gifts, or to one who is proud, that gift, becomes useless like the clarified butter that is poured upon a forest-fire.

sa: ततो बृहस्पति शक्रः प्राञ्जलिः समुपस्थितः। तमुवाच महाप्राज्ञः श्रेय इच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: Shakra then, with joined hands, approached Brihaspati. Endued with great wisdom, the god of the celestials addressed to the great preceptor, saying,-I desire you to tell me the source of happiness.

sa: अचीर्णब्रह्मचर्यो यः सृष्ट्वा वर्तयते पुनः। तदस्त्रं सानुबन्धस्य मूर्धानं तस्य कृन्तति॥
en: If one who had not practised the vow of Brahmacharya tries to withdraw it after having shot it, it strikes off his own head and kills him with all his equipment's.

sa: संवत्सरेण मासाशी पूयते नात्र संशयः। तथैवोपवसन् राजन् स्वल्पेनापि प्रपूयते॥ क्रतुना चाश्वमेधेन पूयते नात्र संशयः। ये चाप्यवभृथस्नाताः केचिदेवंविधा नराः॥ ते सर्वे धूतपाप्मानो भवन्तीति परा श्रुतिः। ब्राह्मणार्थे हतो युद्धे मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया॥
en: By living upon one meal a month, one may be cleansed in a year. By an absolute fast, one may be cleansed within a very short time, one is again purified by a Horse-sacrifice. Men that have been guilty of Brahmanicide and who have succeeded in taking the final bath at the completion of the Horse-sacrifice, become washed off all their sins. This is highly authoritative injunction of the Shrutis. One again, by renouncing his life in a battle undertaking for a Brahmana, becomes cleansed of the sin of Brahmanicide.

sa: एवं चैव नरव्याघ्र लोकत्रयविधातकाः। निग्राह्या एव सततं बाहुभ्यां ये स्युरीदृशाः॥
en: But they, O foremost of kings, who wish to have such honour, though they may be obstacles to the three worlds, should always be repressed by the strength of your arms.

sa: तांस्तु कामवशं प्राप्तान् रागो नाम समस्पृशत्। रक्ताश्च नाभ्यजानन्त कार्याकार्ये युधिष्ठिर॥
en: When they became subject to lust, another passion, named anger, soon attacked them. Once subject to anger, they lost all considerations of what should be done and what should not be.

sa: तस्य पार्थो महाराज नाराचान् वै चतुर्दश॥ मर्माण्युद्दिश्य मर्मज्ञो निचखान हसन्निव।
en: Acquainted with the vital parts of the body, the son of Pritha, however, O king, struck the king of the Madras with fourteen cloth-yard shafts, aiming at the latter's vital parts.

sa: अन्ये च वेदविद्वांसः कृतप्रज्ञा द्विजातयः। गृहस्थाः स्नातकाः सन्तो ददृशुः कुरुसत्तमम्॥
en: Many other Rishis, of great wisdom and well versed in the Vedic in the Vedic Lore. living as householders or belonging to the Snataka class, came to see the Kuru king.

sa: शक्यं तु मौनमास्थाय बिभ्रताऽऽत्मानमात्मना। धर्मच्छद्म समास्थाय च्यवितुं न तु जीवितुम्॥
en: He who can support life by prowess, he who can support himself by his own exertions, does note live, but really deviates from his duty, by following the life of Renunciation.

sa: तेषां सान्त्वं क्रूरमिश्रं प्रणेतव्यं पुनः पुनः। सम्पीड्यमाना हि पर्योगमायान्ति सर्वतः॥
en: A king should, therefore, at all times, use the means of conciliation, accompanied with hard measures. When people are assailed by enemies they always display a tendency to come to terms.

sa: महतस्तमसः पारे पुरुषं ह्यतितेजसम्। यं ज्ञात्वा मृत्युमत्येति तस्मै ज्ञेयात्मने नमः॥
en: You are the One Being of transcendent effulgence dwelling beyond darkness Knowing you one has no fear of death. Salutations of you in that form which is an object of knowledge.

sa: शयानं चानुशेते हि तिष्ठन्तं चानुतिष्ठति। अनुधावति धावन्तं कर्म पूर्वकृतं नरम्॥
en: Pristine actions closely follow a man, so much so that they lie by him when he lies down, stand by him when he stands, and run with him when he runs.

sa: राजा राष्ट्रं यथाऽऽपत्सु द्रव्यौघैरपि रक्षति। राष्ट्रेण राजा व्यसने रक्षितव्यस्तथा भवेत्॥
en: As the king protects, by spending all his money, the kingdom, when it is in distress, so should the kingdom protect the kingdom protect the king when he is in distress.

sa: तांस्तादृशानहं हत्वा धर्मनित्यान् महीक्षितः। असकृत् सोमपान् वीरान् किं प्राप्स्यामि तपोधन॥
en: Having brought about the death of so many heroic kings who were always righteous and all of whom had drunk Soma in sacrifices, what end shall I obtain, O great ascetic.

sa: अरक्षिता दुविनीतो मानी स्तब्धोऽभ्यसूयकः। एनसा युज्यते राजा दुर्दान्त इति चोच्यते॥
en: That king who does not protect his subjects, whose passions are not under-control, who is full of vanity, who is haughty and malicious, incurs sin and becomes notorious as a tyrant.

sa: पश्य शान्तनवं कृष्ण शयानं सूर्यवर्चसम्। युगान्त इव कालेन पतितं सूर्यमम्बरात्॥
en: Behold the son of Shantanu, O Krishna, that hero effulgent like the sun, stretched on the Earth, like the Sun himself dropped off the sky at the end of the Yuga.

sa: यस्मादेवमपापं मां पाप हिंसितुमिच्छसि। तस्मात् स्वयोनिमापन्नः श्वैव त्वं हि भविष्यसि॥
en: Since, however, O sinful wretch, you wish to kill me who have done no injury to you, you will assume the form of your own species and be a dog again.

sa: तेषां वृद्ध्यां हि वृद्धिों मा क्रुधः पुरुषर्षभ। वासुदेववचः श्रुत्वा सीरभृत् प्राह धर्मवित्॥ धर्मः सुचरितः सद्भिः स च द्वाभ्यां नियच्छति। अर्थश्चात्यर्थलुब्धस्य कामश्चातिप्रसङ्गिणः॥
en: On their advancement depends our own. Do not, therefore, give away to anger, O foremost of men!'-Hearing these words of Vasudeva the wielder of the plough, who was well read in the Ethical lore, said, 'Morality is always followed by the good. Morality is always followed by two motives, viz., the desire for Profit cherished by those that follow it, or the desire for Pleasure.

sa: वधबन्धकृतं दुःखं स्त्रीकृतं सहजं तथा। दुःख सुतेन सततं जनान् विपरिवर्तते॥
en: Misery originates from death and imprisonment. Misery arises from women and from other natural causes. The misery that originates from the death of children changes and afflicts all creatures very greatly.

sa: यथा हि पुरुषः खात्वा कूपमप्राप्य चोदकम्। पङ्कदिग्धो निवर्तेत कर्मेदं नस्तथोपमम्॥
en: This act of our refusing the kingdom is like that of a person who having dug a well stops in his work before obtaining water and comes up covered with mire.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तमेवंवादिनं पार्थं बन्धुशोकेन विह्वलम्॥ मैवमित्यब्रवीद् व्यासो निगृह्य मुनिसत्तमः।
en: Vaishampayana said Preventing Pritha's son, who beside himself with sorrow on account of his kinsmen, gave vent to such words, Vyasa, that best of ascetics, said, first telling him,-'This cannot be.'

sa: अन्धं तम इवेदं स्यान्न प्राज्ञायत किंचना दण्डश्चेन्न भवेल्लोके विभजन साध्वसाधुनी॥
en: If there were no chastisement in the world differentiating the good from the evil, the whole world would have been covered with sheer darkness and all things would have been unsettled.

sa: ततः श्वा द्वीपितां नीतो जाम्बूनदनिभाकृतिः। चित्राङ्गो विस्फुरदंष्ट्रो वने वसति निर्भयः॥
en: Thereat, the dog was metamorphosed into a leopard with skin bright as gold. With stripes on his body and with huge teeth, thenceforth he began to live in that forest fearlessly.

sa: धूपैरञ्जनयोगैश्च नस्यकर्मभिरेव च॥ भेषजैः स चिकित्स्यः स्याद् य उन्मार्गेण गच्छति।
en: The man who behaves like a mad, man should be subjected to medical treatment by the aid of incense and collyrium, of drugs applied through the nose, and of other medicaments.

sa: ततः किरीटी भृशमुग्रनि:स्वनं महाशरं सर्पविषानलोपमम्। अयस्मयं रौद्रमसहास्त्रसम्भृतं महाहवे क्षेप्तुमना महामतिः॥
en: Then in that great battle Dhananjaya wished to discharge a dreadful, great steel arrow, like a serpent or fire in force and sending forth a sound like that of Indra's thunderbolt.

sa: निर्भर्त्सयित्वा राज्ञस्तांस्तृणीकृत्य सुयोधनम्। राधेयं भीषयित्वा च सौबलं च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Finding fault with these and holding up Suyodhana to ridicule, describing him as a straw again and again I tried to frighten the son of Radha and the son of Subala.

sa: अत्र धर्मश्च सत्यं च कर्म चात्र निगद्यते। गतिरेषा द्विजश्रेष्ठ कर्मणामवसायिनाम्॥
en: Here are virtue and truth, here the acts of men bear fruit and this is the refuge, O foremost among the twice born, of the acts of those that are dead.

sa: सर्वभूतरुतज्ञा त्वं पश्य बुद्ध्या समन्विता। केन चाश्रयवान् प्राप्तो ममैष भ्रातृगन्धिकः॥
en: “You are acquainted with the voice of all creatures; (therefore) by the exercise of your intelligence ascertain, whose assistance, this being who bears the relation of brother to me, has obtained.

sa: कच्चित् पुत्रा जीवपुत्राः सुसम्यम् वर्तन्ते वो वृत्तिमनृशंसरूपाः। दजातशत्रुः कुशली सपुत्रः॥
en: “O you with living sons, do your sons treat you properly" saying this, O Sanjaya, afterwards tell them that he who has created no enemies is doing well with his sons.

sa: अभयं यस्य भूतेभ्यः सर्वेषामभयं यतः। स वै परिणतप्रज्ञः प्रख्यातो मनुजोत्तमः॥
en: He that has no fear from other creatures and from whom other creatures have no fear, is a man of ripe wisdom and is knows as the best of human beings.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्राः कालपक्वा न चेच्छृण्वन्ति मे वचः। शेष्यन्ते निहता भूमौ श्वशृगालादनीकृताः॥
en: If the sons of Dhritarashtra, whose time is now arrived, do not hear my advice; then they will sleep dead on the bare earth and be food for dogs and jackals.

sa: पाणौ गृहीत्वा विदुरं सात्यकिं च महायशाः। ज्योतीष्यादित्यवद् राजन् कुरून् प्राच्छादयच्छ्रिया।।३३।
en: Getting hold of the hand of Vidura and that of Satyaki (on either side) the one of great fame (entered the Assembly-Hall) eclipsing the Kurus (planets) in splendour like the sun.

sa: नाहं कामान संरम्भान द्वेषान्नार्थकारणात्। न हेतुवादाल्लोभाद् वा धर्म जह्यां कथंचन॥
en: 'I never abandon virtue from motives of desire or from wrath or from hate or from the object of gaining my objects or for the sake of argument or from covetousness.

sa: यथा पुरस्तात् सविता दृश्यते शुक्रमुच्चरन्। यथा च पश्चान्निर्मुक्तो ध्रुवं पर्येति रश्मिवान्॥ तथा सत्यं ब्रवीम्येतन्नास्ति तस्य व्यतिक्रमः। हन्ताहं गदयाभ्येत्य दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥ इति स्म मध्ये भ्रातॄणां सत्येनालभसे गदाम्। तस्य ते प्रशमे बुद्धिर्धियतेऽद्य परंतप॥
en: As surely the sun is seen in the east rising and blazing forth his radiance and as surely that body of light afterwards sets after revolving round Meru; so truly shall I kill wrathful Duryodhana with a blow of this mace. war I speak this truly and there will be no swerving from this oath of mine. With this oath at one time did you handle the mace in the midst of your brothers. At this time however the inclinations of you, O chastiser of your enemies, who are such; point towards peace.

sa: उदतिष्ठत् ततः पार्थो भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः। गाण्डीवधन्वा ये चान्ये राजानस्तत्र केचन॥
en: Rose up from their seats as also did the son of Pritha, and Vrikodara of fierce deeds and the wielder of the Gandiva bow and the other kings that were there.

sa: चतुर्वेदोऽपि दुर्वृत्तः स शूद्रादतिरिच्यते। योऽग्निहोत्रपरो दान्तः स ब्राह्मण इति स्मृतः॥
en: Even he who has studied the four Vedas but whose conduct is wicked cannot be distinguished from Shudra. He who celebrates the Agnihotra and of subdued passions is called a Brahmana.

sa: अस्मात् परस्त्वेष महाधनुष्मान्। पुत्रः कुलिन्दाधिपतेर्वरिष्ठः॥ निरीक्षते त्वां विपुलायताक्षः सुपुष्पितः पर्वतवासनित्यः।
en: Behind him is the great bowman that one of arge eyes, adorned with blazing garlands gazing on you, the famous son of the king of Kulinda. Who always lives on mountain.

sa: मनुष्यसम्भवा वाचो विधर्मिण्य: प्रतिश्रुताः॥ भवतां दिव्यवाचस्तु ता भवन्तु कथं मृषा।
en: O high-minded and mighty-armed enhancer of the glory of the Kurus, human promises may not be fulfilled, but how is it that celestials words with regard to you have proved untrue?

sa: स क्रोधलोभौ मोहवानन्तरात्मा स वै मृत्युस्त्वच्छरीरे य एषः। एवं मृत्यु जायमानं विदित्वा ज्ञाने तिष्ठन् न बिभेतीह मृत्योः। र्मृत्योर्यथा विषयं प्राप्य मर्त्यः॥
en: That inner soul exists in your body, wedded to wrath and desire as it is like death; and knowing that death is generated in this way, the person who puts his faith in knowledge is not afraid of death. Death itself is destroyed when it comes under the influence of knowledge, even as earthly beings are destroyed when they come under the influence of death.

sa: न त्वं परस्यानुचरस्तात जीवितुमर्हसि। अहं हि क्षत्रहदयं वेद यत् परिशाश्वतम्॥
en: O my dear son, it is not proper that you should live on being the subject of another. I know what the eternal essence of the heart of a Kshatriya is?

sa: अमोघां देहि मे शक्तिममित्रविनिबर्हिणीम्। दास्यामि ते सहस्राक्ष कुण्डले वर्म चोत्तमम्॥
en: You will say to him, “O thousand-eyed lord, I will give you the two ear-rings and the excellent armour, if you will bestow on me an infallible dart destructive of enemies."

sa: शब्दं च घोरं सत्त्वानां दावाग्नेरिव वर्धतः। अपश्येतां मुहूर्ताच्च कबधं घोरदर्शनम्॥
en: And they heard a terrible uproar of various creatures like that which is heard during a forest-fire spreading far and wide. In a moment they saw headless trunk of terrible appearance,

sa: किं चाप्येतेन तत्कर्म कृतपूर्वं सुदुष्करम्। तैर्यथा पाण्डवैः सर्वैरेकैकेन कृतं पुरा॥
en: What difficult task of there that has before been accomplished by him which is equal to what has been done by each of the sons of Pandu in days gone by.

sa: भवतैव हि रक्ष्यास्ते व्यसनेषु विशेषतः। मा ते धर्मस्तथैवार्थो नश्येत भरतर्षभ॥
en: By you they ought to be protected and especially when in distress. Let not your sense of virtue and appreciation of worldly good be lost, O best of the Bharata race.

sa: अत्रामृतं सुरैः पीत्वा निहितं निहतारिभिः। अतः सोमस्य हानिश्च वृद्धिश्चैव प्रदृश्यते॥
en: Here the gods, who had slain their enemies, having drunk the nectar kept the residue there. It is from here proceed the growth and decline of the moon, which we see.

sa: तथाशीलसमाचारे राजन् मा प्रणयं कृथाः। वध्यास्ते सर्वलोकस्य किं पुनस्तव भारत॥
en: With one who is of such habits of life, do not, O king, contract a friendship; they are fit to be killed by any man; then why not by you, OBharata.

sa: स राजानं कुन्तिभोजमब्रवीत् सुमहातपाः। भिक्षामिच्छामि वै भोक्तुं तव गेहे विमत्सर॥
en: That Brahmana of great and excellent devotion said to king Kuntibhoja "O being that is free from pride, I am desirous of eating at your house (the food) obtained as alms.

sa: कृतार्थाः सुभृता ये हि कृत्यकाले झुपस्थिते। अनवेक्ष्य कृतं पापा विकुर्वन्त्यनवस्थिताः॥
en: Those wretches who, well cared for and well-supported, at the approach of the time when something should be done in return for these acts of kindness, act in an ungraceful manner,

sa: यो माहेन्द्रं धनुलेंभे तुल्यं गाण्डीवतेजसा। शाङ्गेण च महाबाहुः सम्मितं दिव्यलक्षणम्॥
en: Who, having long arms, obtained the Vijaya bow of the great Indra himself which was equal in energy to the Gandiva and to the Sharanga which had celestial attributes in it.

sa: योगात् कृत्वा द्विधाऽऽत्मानमाजगाम तताप च। आबभाषे ततः कुन्ती साम्ना परमवल्गुना॥
en: Having recourse to Yoga he divided himself in twain, one of which began to impart heat and the other appeared (before Kunti). He then addressed Kunti in very sweet words thus,

sa: विदुर उवाच राजन् बहुतमश्चासि त्रैलोक्यस्यापि सत्तमः। सम्भावितश्च लोकस्य सम्मतश्चासि भारत॥
en: Vidura said O king, you are thought very well of in the there worlds, indeed as, the best of men. You are beloved by the world and respected as well, OBharata.

sa: सा समीक्ष्य तथारूपमनाथामेकवाससम्। समाहूयाब्रवीद् भद्रे का त्वं किं च चिकीर्षसि॥
en: Beholding her thus plighted, unprotected and clad in a single piece of cloth, she (Virata's wife) addressed her saying “O gentle one, who are you and what you desire to do.”

sa: विषेण सर्पबन्धैश्च यतिताः पाण्डवास्त्वया। सर्वोपायैर्विनाशाय न समृद्धं च तत् तव॥
en: By poison, by snake, and by rope, in fact by every means was the destruction of the sons of Pandu attempted by you but that attempt of yours was not successful.

sa: उषिताश्च वने कृच्छ्रे वयं द्वादश वत्सरान्। अज्ञातवाससमयं शेषं वर्षं त्रयोदशम्॥
en: We have in great misery dwelt in the woods (these) twelve years. The thirteenth year, which we are to spend incognito yet remains, (Therefore) permit us to spend this year unrecognized.

sa: शैक्यां तात चतुष्किष्कुं षडस्रिममितौजसम्। प्रहितां दुःखसंस्पर्शी कथं शक्ष्यन्ति मे सुताः॥
en: How shall my sons bear, Odear, the mace when flung at them the mace which is four cubits long, having six sides of illimitable powers of destruction and terrible to touch.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच भगवान् देवकीपुत्रो लोकांचेनिहनिष्यति। प्रवदन्नर्जुने सख्यं नाहं गच्छेऽद्य केशवम्॥
en: Duryodhana said If the son of Devaki, that divine Being, destroys the worlds the worlds, having recourse to the co-operation of Arjuna; even then shall I not seek refuge under Keshava.

sa: तत्र बद्धमनोदृष्टिरभवत् सा सुमध्यमा। न चातप्यत रूपेण भानोः संध्यागतस्य सा॥
en: And both the mind and the eye of that slender-waisted girl were steadfastly fixed on the solar orb. She did not feel satiety at beholding the beauty of the morning sun.

sa: यत्र दानपतिं शूरं क्षुधिताः पृथिवीचराः। प्राप्य तुष्टाः प्रतिष्ठन्ते धर्मः कोऽभ्यधिकस्ततः॥
en: Who earns greater virtue than he who is a hero and the foremost among the gift makers, coming in contract with whom hungry beings of the earth have their hunger satisfied?

sa: इत्युक्तवचनं रामं प्रत्युवाचानिलात्मजः। प्रियमाख्यामि ते राम दृष्टा सा जानकी मया॥
en: Rama having said this, Hanuman the son of the wind-god thus replied to him. “O Rama, I am giving you good news. The daughter of Janaka has been seen by me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत् तु वाक्यमनादृत्य सोऽर्थवन्मातृभाषितम्। पुनः प्रतस्थे संरम्भात् सकाशमकृतात्मनाम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Treating with contempt those words spoken by his mother which were pregnant with good sense, the one, of unsubdued soul, again went to his own place fired with wrath.

sa: दौरात्म्यं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य क्षत्रियाणां च वैरताम्। सर्वमेतदहं जानन् क्षत्तः प्राप्तोऽद्य कौरवान्॥
en: The wickedness of soul of the sons of Dhritarashtra and the hostility of the Kshatriyas, knowing full well, all this, 0 Khattva have I now come to the sons of Kuru.

sa: नास्यानिष्टानि सेवेत नाहितैः सह संवदेत्। स्वस्थानान्न विकम्पेत स राजवसतिं वसेत्॥
en: He alone can live in a royal house who does not swerve from his place, nor does him any injury, nor associates with those who are unfriendly to him (the king).

sa: सहायोऽस्मि स्थितोयुद्धे यदि भीतोऽसि पाण्डवा करिष्यामि रणे साह्यमसह्यं तव शत्रुभिः॥
en: If, O son of Pandu, you are afraid on the eve of the war I shall afford you assistance. The assistance, I will give, cannot possibly be borne by your enemies.

sa: यदब्रुवमहं कृष्ण कटुकानि स्म पाण्डवान्। प्रियार्थं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य तेन तप्ये ह्यकर्मणा॥
en: What harsh words, I said to the sons of Pandu, O Krishna, were for the gratification of the son of Dhritarashtra and I am now struck with remorse for that misdeed.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य नरव्याघ्र त्वत्तो भिक्षां गतव्यथः। कृत्वापवर्ग गुरवे चरिष्यति महत् तपः॥
en: Having accepted from you along, O you best among men and thus being beyond the reach of sorrow after fulfilling his pledge to his spiritual guide, he will practice great asceticism.

sa: उपायास्यति दाशार्हः पाण्डवार्थं पराक्रमी। स नो मान्यश्च पूज्यश्च सर्वथा मधुसूदनः॥
en: The powerful scion of Dasharha race is coming here for the sake of the Pandavas; and that slayer of Madhu is by all means the object of our respect and regard.

sa: नित्योद्विग्नमिदं सर्वं नित्योद्विग्नमिदं मनः। यत् तत् पदमनुद्विग्नं तन्मे वद महामते॥
en: Everything seems to be a source of anxiety. Hence my mind is constantly filled with anxiety. O you of great intelligence, speak to me what is calculated to remove my anxiety.

sa: किं कार्यमवशिष्टं वो हतस्त्वाष्ट्रो महासुरः। वृत्रश्च सुमहाकायो यो वै लोकाननाशयत्॥
en: What is there still remaining to be done. The great Asura, the son of Tvashtri, has been killed and so has been Vritra of large stature who destroyed the three worlds.

sa: नेदं मनुष्याः संदध्युन हीदं तेषु विद्यते। पौराणानां महास्त्राणां विचित्रोऽयं समागमः॥
en: As this arm is not with other people, they cannot use this divine arm for battle. An excellent conglomeration of the powerful arms has been made only in this battle here.

sa: न ते राज्यं प्रयच्छन्ति विना युद्धेन पाण्डव। विनाशहेतवः सर्वे प्रत्युपस्थितमृत्यवः॥
en: They will not give up the kingdom without war, O son of Pandu. All, of them being the cause of a universal massacre, are coming within the very pale of death.

sa: वाच्यावाच्यं न जानीघे नूनं मामवमन्यसे। भीष्मद्रोणमुखान् सर्वान् कस्मान्न स विजेष्यति॥
en: Have you not an idea of what is proper and what is not proper? Forsooth, you insult me. Why should he not defcat all the heroes headed by Bhishma and Drona?

sa: मातोवाच पुत्र नात्मावमन्तव्यः पूर्वाभिरसमृद्धिभिः। अभूत्वा हि भवन्त्यर्था भूत्वा नश्यन्ति चापरे।
en: The mother said O son, your mind should not be insulted by anticipation's of failure. Objects unattained at first are gained subsequently and other objects attained at first are lost afterwards.

sa: एष वृद्धाननाथांश्च पङ्गुनन्धांश्च मानवान्। पुत्रवत् पालयामास प्रजा धर्मेण वै विभुः॥
en: He used to provide senior people, orphans, handicapped and blind people of state with proper maintenance. This king used to defend his subjects like son with all legitimate means and resources.

sa: यैषा नर्तनशालेह मत्स्यराजेन कारिता। दिवात्र कन्या नृत्यन्ति रात्रौ यान्ति यथागृहम्॥
en: There is the dancing house which the king of the Matsya's has caused to be built; there the girls dance during the day and retire to their respective homes at night.

sa: तं च पुत्रात् प्रियतमं प्रतियोत्स्ये धनंजयम्। क्षात्रं धर्ममनुष्ठाय धिगस्तु क्षत्रजीविकाम्॥
en: With him who is dear to me than my son namely Dhananjaya, shall I have to fight in observing the duties of a Kshatriya. Fie on the profession of a Kshatriya.

sa: तत् समर्थं शुभं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। धार्तराष्ट्रः सहामात्यो ग्रहीतुं विदुरार्हति॥
en: It is proper therefore, O Vidura, for the son of Dhritarashtra along with his ministers to accept my blessed advice capable of doing good and consistent with morality and worldly profit.

sa: शल्य उवाच महर्षिवचनं श्रुत्वा तानुवाच महाद्युतिः। अवश्यं भगवन्तो मे माननीयास्तपस्विनः॥
en: Shalya said The being with great luster, having heard the speech of the great Rishis, said to them! O devotees, O lord, you are, of course, to be honoured by me.

sa: तैरयुद्धं साधु मन्ये कुरवस्तन्निबोधत। युद्धे विनाशः कृत्स्नस्य कुलस्य भविता ध्रुवम्॥
en: I consider that it is best not to fight with them; you, Kurus, follow that (my opinion). If you wage war, destruction will surely overtake the race which will be extinct.

sa: अप्सरा देवकन्या वा माया वा देवनिर्मिता। इति कृत्वाञ्जलिं सर्वे ददृशुस्तामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: (Thinking): “Is she an Apsara or the daughter of a god or a celestials phantom,” they all with joined hands, stood gazing on the perfect and faultless beauty of her person.

sa: अग्निस्तेजो महल्लोके गूढस्तिष्ठति दारुषु। न चोपयुक्ते तद् दारु यावन्नोद्दीप्यते परैः॥
en: The energy of fire is great in this world. It lurks and hides itself in the wood and yet does not consume the wood, till it is put ablaze by others.

sa: अहं संस्तम्भयिष्यामि मा भैस्त्वं शक्रतो नृप। सर्वेषामेव देवानां क्षयितान्यायुधानि मे॥
en: You have nothing to fear from the God of a Hundred Sacrifices, I shall use my staying charms, O king, and the weapons of all the gods will avail them not.

sa: यथा कर्म कृतं लोके तथैतानुपद्यते॥ यनैव गन्धिनो रस्यं न रूपस्पर्शशब्दवत्। मन्यन्ते मुनयो बुद्ध्या तत् प्रधानं प्रचक्षते॥ तत्र प्रधानमव्यक्तमव्यक्तस्य गुणो महान्।
en: And as action is performed in this world, so does it result to those who perform them. That which is void of smell. void of taste, and void of touch and sound, that which is meditated upon by the sages with the help of their understanding is said to be Pradhana. Now, Pradhana is unmanifest. A development of the uninanife-t is Mahat.

sa: क्षत्रियेष्वाश्रितो धर्मः प्रजानां परिपालनम्। क्षत्राद् वृत्तिर्ब्राह्मणानां तैः कथं ब्राह्मणो वरः॥
en: The duty of protecting all creatures lies with the Kshatriyas. It is from the Kshatriyas that the Brahmanas derive their livelihood. How then can the Brahmana be superior to the Kshatriyas?

sa: सोमपानां च देवानामूष्मषाणां तथैव च। उञ्छन्ति ये समीपस्थाः सदारा नियतेन्द्रियाः॥
en: These live near the Somadrinking celestials and others that drink flames of fire. With their wedded wives and with passions under complete restraint, they too live upon the rays of Soma.

sa: प्राहुर्वाक्संयतं विप्रं धर्मनैपुणदर्शिनः। मित्रेषु यश्च विषमः स्तेन इत्येव तं विदुः॥
en: Utanka said Those who are skilled in the rules of duty, say that Brahmanas are of controlled speech. One who acts wrongly towards friends is considered as vile as a thief.

sa: परिचर्यां वने तां तु क्षुत्प्रतीघातकारिकाम्। अन्योन्येन निवेद्याथ प्रातिष्ठन्त सहैव ते॥
en: Conversing then with each other about the difficulty of getting sustenance in that forest and the consequent necessity of under going the pangs of hunger, all of them left that place.

sa: स पर्यपृच्छत् तं पुत्रं क्षीणं पर्यागतं पुनः। दिव्यैर्गन्धैः समादिग्धं क्षीणस्वप्नमिवोत्थितम्॥
en: The son, just restored to life, was still weak. His body was smeared with scents and the looked like one just awaking from a deep sleep. The Rishi asked hiin, saying.

sa: अल्पप्रज्ञो विरूपाक्ष कथं भवति मानवः। एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि सर्वधर्मविदां वर॥
en: By what acis, again, docs one become of little wisdom and distorted vision? Do you remove this doubt of mine. O you who are the foremost of all beings knowing duties.

sa: सखिभार्यां गुरोर्भार्यां राजभार्यां तथैव च। प्रधर्षयित्वा कामाया मृतो जायति सूकरः॥
en: He who, through lust, knows the wife of a friend, or the wife of preceptor, or the wife of his king, has after death to take the form of a hog.

sa: चक्षुरुवाच नेमे बाणास्तरिष्यन्ति मामलर्क कथंचन। तवैव मर्म भेत्स्यन्ति भिन्नमर्मा मरिष्यसि॥
en: Thc eye said, These arrows will not, O Alarka, pass through me at all. They will pierce your own vital parts lonely, and your vital parts being cut, you shall die.

sa: भ्रातुर्भार्यो तु पापात्मा यो धर्षयति मोहितः। पुस्कोकिलत्वमाप्नोति सोऽपि संवत्सरं नृप॥
en: That sinful wight who out of foolishness, knows his brother's wife, has to take birth as a male Coel and to live in that form for a whole year, O king.

sa: हवींषि सर्वाणि यथा [पभुङ्क्ते हुताशनः। एवं त्वमपि धर्मात्मन् पुरुषाग्निः प्रतापवान्॥
en: The blazing sacrificial fire eats all the oblations of clarified butter poured upon it. Of pious soul, and gifted with great energy, you are among men, a blazing fire in energy.

sa: गवां सहस्र संख्याता तदा सा पशुपैर्मम। सा ब्राह्मणाय दत्ता प्रेत्यार्थमभिकाइक्षता॥
en: The keepers of my cattle included that cow in their list of a thousand. In time that cow was given away by me to a Brahmana, wishing for liappiness in heaven.

sa: भीष्मेण सर्वमुक्तोऽसि कृष्णेन विदुरेण च। मयाप्यवश्यं वक्तव्यं प्रीत्या ते नृपसत्तम॥
en: You have been instructed in all duties by Bhishma, by Krishna, and by Vidura, I should, also, O best of kings, from the affection I bear you, give you these instructions.

sa: चारयित्वा परबलं कृत्वा स्वबलदर्शनम्। स्वभूमौ योजयेद् युद्धं परभूमौ तथैव च॥
en: Knowing every thing about the enemy's sirength through spies, and examining his own strength himself, the king should begin war either within his own territories or within those of his cncmy.

sa: निहन्तारं रणेऽरीणां सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। मया विनिहतं संख्ये प्रेक्षते दुर्मरं बत॥
en: Alas, this destroyer of all enemies, this foremost of all wielders of weapons, has been killed by me in battle. It is clear that men do die, till their hour comes.

sa: अन्विष्यतां वै ज्वलनस्तथा चाद्य नियुज्यताम्। तारकस्य वधोपायः कथितो वै मयानघाः॥
en: Let the god of fire, therefore, be searched out. Let him now be set to this task. You sinless ones, I have told you the means for the destruction of Taraka.

sa: परेण तपसा युक्ताः श्रीमन्तो लोकविश्रुताः। लोकानन्वचरन् सिद्धाः सर्व एव भृगूत्तम॥
en: Gifted with penances, of prosperity celebrated over all the worlds, those great ones, all crowned with ascetic success, sojourned over every part of the universe, O foremost one of Bhrigu's race.

sa: स तान् प्रगृह्य भुक्त्वा च र तुष्टिमगमद् द्विजः। तमुच्छवृत्तिरालक्ष्य ततश्चिन्तापरोऽभवत्॥
en: The Brahmana, having accepted that quantity, immediately ate it up, but his hunger was not yet satisfied. Secing him ungratified, the Brahmana in the observance of the Unchcha vow became thoughtful.

sa: पावनं सर्वभूतानां तेजोद्युतिविवर्धनम्। विपाप्मा च स तेजस्व तेन क्रतुफलेन च॥
en: That sacrifice purifies all creatures and increases the energy and splendour of those who succeed in celebrating it. Gifted with great energy, Rama, by the celebration of that sacrifice, became sinless.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच त्वगस्थिमांसमुत्सृज्य तैश्च भूतैर्विवर्जितः। जीवःस भगवन् क्वस्थः सुखदुःखे समश्नुते॥
en: Yudhishthira said Living off skin, bone and flesh, and becoming destitute of all those elements, in what does individual soul reside, O illustrious one, for enjoying and suffering happiness and imisery?

sa: राजमार्गे गवां मध्ये धान्यमध्ये च धर्मिणः। नोपसेवन्ति राजेन्द्र सर्ग मूत्रपूरीषयोः॥
en: The good or the righteous, O king, never answer the two calls of nature on the public road, or in the midst of a cowpen or on a field of paddy.

sa: विद्यते न भयं चापि परलोकान्ममानधाः। किं तु तस्य सुदुर्बुद्धेर्मन्दस्यापनयैर्भृशम्॥ दूयते मे मनो नित्यं स्मरतः पृत्रगृद्धिनः। अपापाः पाण्डवा येन निकृताः पापबुद्धिना॥
en: O sinless ones, I have no longer any fear about my end in the next world. Full as I am of love for my children, I always remember them. My mind, however is always pained by the recollection of the various acts of wrong which my wicked of exceedingly evil understanding perpetrated. Having a sinful understanding, he always persecuted the innocent Pandavas.

sa: इच्छन्नापि हि लोकांस्त्री जीवयेथा मृतानिमान्। किं पुनर्दयितं जातं स्वस्रीयस्यात्मजं मृतम्॥
en: If only you wish it, you can revive the three worlds (of being) if dead! What need, I say, therefore, of this darling child, born but dead, of your sister's son?

sa: गुणांस्तु शृणु मे राजन् सान्त्वस्य भरतर्षभ। दारुणान्यपि भूतानि सान्त्वेनाराधयेद् यथा॥
en: Listen to me, O king, as I explain to you the merits of Conciliation, O chief of Bharata's race so that the most furious creatures may be cooled down by it.

sa: स्नानेनादिश्च यत् कर्म क्रियते वै विपश्चिता। नमस्कारप्रयुक्तेन तेन प्रीयन्ति देवताः॥
en: Those rites which the learned perform in course of their ablutions, and with the help of waters, accompanied with bows to the gods, always contribute to the satisfaction of the celestials.

sa: पाहि सर्वाः प्रजाः सम्यक् शुभाशुभविदात्मवान्। शुभैः संविभजन् कामैरशुभानां च पावनैः॥
en: Ascertaining what is right and what is wrong, and purifying your soul, do you duly cherish and protect all creatures, judiciously satisfying all good desires and correcting all that is unholy.

sa: नाशकत् तानि मघवा जेतुं सर्वायुधैरपि। अथ सर्वेऽमरा रुद्रं जग्मुः शरणमर्दिताः॥
en: With all his weapons, Maghavat the chief of the celestials, was unable to pierce those cities. Afflicted by the Asuras, all the celestials then sought the protection of the great Rudra.

sa: ये भृत्यभरणे शक्ताः सततं चातिथिव्रताः। भुञ्जते देवशेषाणि तान् नमस्यामि यादव।॥
en: I bow to them, O Yadava, who feed and cherish their servants who are always hospitable to guests and who eat only the residue of what is offered to the deities.

sa: कृत्वातिपातकं कर्म यो दद्यादन्नमर्थिने। ब्राह्मणाय विशेषेण न स पापेन मुह्यते॥
en: That person who having committed even a heinous crime makes a gift of food to one who solicits, or to a Brahmana in special, is never stupefied by that heinous sin.

sa: चतुर्विधा भिक्षवस्ते कुटीचकबहूदकौ। हंसः परमहंसश्च यो यः पश्चात् स उत्तमः॥
en: Bhikshus (mendicants) are of four kinds. They are Kutichakas, Bahudakas, Hansas, and Paramahansas. The second is superior to the first, the third to the second, and the fourth to the third.

sa: सत्येन सूर्यस्तपति सत्येनाग्निः प्रदीप्यते। सत्येन मरुतो वान्ति सर्वं सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: It is by Truth that the Sun is giving heat it is by Truth that fire bums up it is by Truth that the winds blow; indeed, everything rests upon Truth;

sa: तेषामग्निपरिस्यन्दः पितॄणां चार्चनं तथा। यज्ञानां चैव पञ्चानां यजनं धर्म उच्यते॥
en: They pour libations of clarified butter on the sacred fire, and worship the departed Manes under proper forms. They also celebrate the wellknown sacrifices. This is said to form their religion.

sa: कर्तुमर्हसि धर्मज्ञ दयां कुरुकुलोद्वह॥ विस्मृत्य कुरुराजानं तं च मन्दं जयद्रथम्।
en: O perpetuator of Kuru's race, O you who are fully conversant with every duty, you should show mercy to this child, forgetting the Kuru prince (Duryodhana) and the wicked Jayadratha. in

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स सुरेन्द्रेण ततो देवपुरोहितः। बृहस्पतिवृहत्तेजाः प्रत्युवाच शतक्रतुम्॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the king of the celestials, the preceptor of the gods, viz., Brihaspati of great energy, said these words in reply to him of a hundred sacrifices.

sa: तेषां किरीटी संकल्पं मांघं चक्रे महाबलः॥ सर्वांस्तानन्तराच्छित्त्वा तदा चुक्रोश पाण्डवः।
en: The diadem-decked Dhananjaya of great power baffled their aim by cutting off all those weapons before any of them could reach him. At length the son of Pandu became highly angry.

sa: भीष्म उवाच जन्मनैव महाभागो ब्राह्मणो नाम जायते। नमस्यः सर्वभूतानामतिथिः प्रसृत्ताग्रभुक्॥
en: Bhishma said O blessed king, a Brahmana, by birth alone becomes an object of worship with all creatures and entitled, as guests, to eat the first portion of all cooked food.

sa: तत्र तत्र हि सिद्धार्थो देवकन्याभिरर्च्यते। फलं बहुसुवर्णस्य यज्ञस्य लभते नरः॥
en: He acquires the merits of a sacrifice in which profuse gold is given away. Proceeding to the regions named, he lives there for numberless years in the enjoyment of greatest happiness.

sa: आर्जवे तु रतो नित्यं वसत्यमरसंनिधौ। तस्मादार्जवयुक्तः स्याद् य इच्छेद् धर्ममात्मनः॥
en: The man who is always devoted to sincerity of conduct, succeeds in acquiring a residence among the celestials. Hence, he who wishes to achieve the merit of virtue, should be sincere.

sa: विहङ्गाश्च मुदा युक्ताः प्रानृत्यन् व्यनदंश्च ह॥ गिरिपृष्ठेषु रम्येषु व्याहरन्तो जनप्रियाः।
en: Various species of birds, filled with joy, danced about and sang merrily on the charming breast of that mountain. Those birds were exceedingly loveable on account of the notes they uttered.

sa: आक्रम्य मार्यमाणाश्च भ्राम्यन्ते वै पुनः पुनः॥ नात्मनोऽस्ति प्रियतरः पृथिवीमनुसृत्य ह।
en: They are assailed and killed and in this way have to travel again and again. There is nothing so dear to one as his life when one comes to this world.

sa: तस्माद् यज्ञफलैस्तुल्यं न किंचिदिह दृश्यते। इति मे वर्तते बुद्धिस्तथा चैतदसंशयम्॥
en: Hence it appears that nothing can be seen in this world which can compare with the fruits of sacrifices. This is my conviction. That conviction, again scems to be surely correct.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वात्यद्भुतं राजा मनसाचिन्तयत् तदा। स्वप्नोऽयं चित्तविभ्रंश उताहो सत्यमेव तु॥
en: Seeing such highly wonderful spectacles, the king began to reflect inwardly, saying-ls this a dream? Or, is all this due to an alienation of my mind? Or is it all real.

sa: अनुराधासु प्रावारं वरानं समुपोषितः। दत्त्वा युगशतं चापि नरः स्वर्गे महीयते॥
en: By making gifts, under the constellation Anuradha, of embroidered cloth and other dresses and of food, observing a fast all the while, one becomes honoured in Heaven for a hundred cycles.

sa: अब्रवीद्धि महातेजाः प्रस्थितं मां युधिष्ठिरः। राजानस्ते न हन्तव्या धनंजय कथंचन॥
en: Indeed, Yudhishthira of great energy said to me while commissioning me for this task even these words, viz., You should not, O Dhananjaya, kill those kings (who may give you battle).

sa: पितॄन् पूज्यादितः पश्चाद्देवतास्तर्पयन्ति वै। तस्मात् तान् सर्वयज्ञेन पुरुषः पूजयेत् सदा॥
en: It is seen that people adore the departed Manes first, and please the celestials next by offering them their worship. Hence, one should always adore the departed Manes with every care.

sa: अस्ति मे बलवानस्मि राजास्मीति युधिष्ठिर। ब्राह्मणान् मा च पर्यश्रीर्वासोभिरशनेन च॥
en: Thinking that you are a king, that you are gifted with great power, and that you have riches do, not, O Yudhishthira, enjoy your affluence without giving anything to the Brahmanas.

sa: फेनपानामृषीणां यो धर्मो धर्मविदां सताम्। तन्मे शृणु महाभागे धर्मज्ञे धर्ममादितः॥
en: O highly blessed one, do you hear, from the beginning, what are the duties of those pious Rishis who know every duty and who are known by the name of Phenapas.

sa: हृष्टानां सिंहनादेन जनानां तत्र नि:स्वनः। प्रविश्य प्रदिशः सर्वाः पुनरेव व्युपारमत्॥
en: The citizens, learning of the birth of the prince, uttered a leonine shout. That noise proceeded to the utmost limit of every point of the compass. Soon, however, that noise ceased,

sa: तेष्वप्रमादं कुर्वीत त्रिषु कर्मसु धर्मवित्। दान्तो मैत्रः क्षमायुक्तः सर्वभूतसमो मुनिः॥
en: Observant of penances, self-controlled, practising universal mercy and forgiveness, and loO king upon all creatures impartially, the man who is conversant with duties should never be careless about those three acts.

sa: पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं कन्यार्थी तामवाप्नुयात्। धनार्थी लभते वित्तं धर्मार्थी धर्ममाप्नुयात्॥
en: He who wishes for sons obtains them. He who desires daughters obtains them. He who desires riches succeeds in acquiring wealth, and he who desires religions merit succeeds in winning it.

sa: भार्याः पतिकृताँल्लोकानाप्नुवन्तीति नः श्रुतम्। त्वामहं पतिमासाद्य कां गमिष्यामि वै गतिम्॥
en: We have heard that a wife attains to those regions which are acquired by her husband. What, indeed, is the goal that I shall attain, having obtained you for my husband.

sa: अथवा त्वां महीपाल शमयिष्यन्ति वै द्विजाः। निरसिष्यन्ति ते राष्ट्राद्धतोत्साहा महाबलाः॥
en: The Brahmanas will either kill you, king, though you are, or, endued with great might as they are, they will drive you away from your kingdom, despoiling you of your energy.

sa: त्यजैनं कलुषं भावं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्कुरु। एतेषां कुर्वतः पापं राष्ट्रक्षोभो भविष्यति॥
en: Then the god of wind, addressing the king from the sky, said, Renounce this sinful attitude. Bow to the Brahmanas. By injuring them you will bring about troubles on your kingdom.

sa: जमदग्नेश्च संवादं सूर्यस्य च महात्मनः। पुरा स भगवान् साक्षाद्धनुषाक्रीडयत् प्रभो॥
en: I shall in this connection, recite the conversation between Jamadagni and the great Sun. Formerly the illustrious Jamadagni, O powerful king, of Bhrigu's race, was engaged in practising with his bow.

sa: यया सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्। तां धेनुं शिरसा वन्दे भूतभव्यस्य मातरम्॥
en: Bending my head to her with respect, I worship the cow who is the mother of both the Past and Future, and by whom the entire universe of mobile and immobile creatures is sustained.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच द्विविधे जायते व्याधिः शारीरो मानसस्तथा। परस्परं तयोर्जन्म निर्द्वन्द्वं नोपपद्यते।।।।
en: There are two kinds of diseases, physical and mental. They are produced by the mutua? action of the body and mind on cach other, and they never originate without the interaction of the two.

sa: कथं नु राजा वृद्धः स पुत्रपौत्रवधार्दितः॥ शोकमस्मत्कृतं प्राप्य न प्रियेतेति चिन्त्यते।
en: They always took care that the old king who was afflicted with the destruction of his sons and grandsons, with, that is, grief caused by the Pandavas themselves, might not die of his grief.

sa: विदितो मे सुदुर्धर्ष नारदाद् देवलात् तथा। कृष्णद्वैपायताच्चैव तथा कुरुपितामहात्॥ त्वयि सर्वे समासक्तं त्वमेवैको जनेश्वरः। यच्चानुग्रहसंयुक्तमेतदुक्तं त्वयानध॥ एतत् सर्वमहं सम्यगाचरिष्ये जनार्दन। इदं चाद्भुतमत्यन्तं कृतमस्मत्प्रियेप्सया॥ यत्पापो निहतः संख्ये कौरव्यो धृतराष्ट्रजः। त्वया दग्धं हि तत्सैन्यं मया विजितमाहवे॥
en: O you who are irresistible. I have learnt it from Narada and Devala and the island-born (Vyasa), and the Kuru grandfather also, that all this (universe) rests on you. You are the one Lord of all creatures. This, O sinless one, that you have described to me on account of your favour for myself, I shall duly accomplish in full, O Janardana! Highly wonderful is this which you have done from desire of doing what is agreeable to us, viz., the destruction in battle of the Kaurava (prince), the son of Dhritarashtra. That army had been burnt by you which I (subsequently) defeated in battle.

sa: परमात्मा हृषीकेश: सर्वव्यापी महेश्वरः। न तस्मात् परमं भूतं त्रिषु लोकेषु किंचन॥
en: He is the Supreme Soul, He is the Worker of all the senses. He covers the universe. He is the Supreme Lord. There is nothing in the three worlds which is superior to Him.

sa: मनसा तु प्रदुष्टेन नग्नां पश्यन्ति ये स्त्रियम्। रोगार्तास्ते भवन्तीह नरा दुष्कृतकर्मिणः॥
en: Those men who, moved by desire in their hearts, cast their eyes on naked women, those men of wicked acts take birth in this world to pass their whole lives in one continuous disease.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच गाव: सुरभिगन्धिन्यस्तथा गुग्गुलुगन्धयः। गाव: प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां गावः स्वस्त्ययनं महत्॥
en: Vashishtha said Kine, are always fragrant. The perfume of the Amyris agallochum comes out of their bodies. Kine are the great refuge of all creatures. Kine form the greet source of blessings to all.

sa: आपश्चुक्षुभिरे चैव चकम्पे च वसुन्धरा। व्यद्रवन् गिरयश्चापि द्यौः पफाल च सर्वशः॥
en: The Ocean rolled in agitation and the Earth trembled to her centre. The hills and mountains began to move from their bases and ran on all sides. The Vault of the sky became cracked.

sa: सर्वाः सुखं संश्रिताश्च शरीरे तस्य देवताः। स देवः पुण्डरीकाक्षः श्रीगर्भः श्रीसहोषितः॥
en: All the celestials, too, live happily in His body. Gitted with great effulgence, He has cyes which resemble lotus petals The goddess (if prosperity lives within Him and He lives always in his company.

sa: न भक्षयन्त्यतो मांसं तपोयुक्ता मनीषिणः। दोषांस्तु भक्षणे राजन् मांसस्येह निबोध मे॥
en: It is therefore, that wise men who are gifted with penances refrain from eating meat. Listen to me, O king, as tell you what the faults are which attach to the eating of meat.

sa: वृकोदरः फाल्गुनश्चैव वीरौ माद्रीपुत्रौ विदुरः संजयश्चा वैश्यापुत्रः सहितो गौतमेन धौम्यो विप्राश्चान्वयुर्बाष्पकण्ठाः॥
en: Vrikodara, the heroic Phalguna, the two sons of Madri, Vidura, Sanjaya, Dhritarashtra's son by his Vaishya wife, and Kripa, and Dhaumya, and other Brahmanas, all followed the old king with voices choked in grief.

sa: मुनिश्च स्यात् सदा विप्रो वेदांश्चैव सदा जपेत्। कुटुम्बिको धर्मकामः सदास्वप्नश्च मानवः॥
en: A Brahmana should always practise self denial controlling even speech, and recite the marry and Vedas. The Brahmana should surround himself with children and relatives, from desire of acquiring virtue. He should never sleep.

sa: स त्वं बृहस्पतिं गच्छ तमनुज्ञाप्य चाव्रज। ततोऽहं याजयिष्ये त्वां यदि यष्टुमिहेच्छसि॥
en: You must therefore go to Brihaspati first, and taking his permission you can return to me, if you have any desire to celebrate a sacrifice, and then only shall I officiate at your sacrifice.

sa: मया च भवतां सम्यक् शुश्रूषा या कृतानघाः॥ असम्यग् वा महाभागास्तत् क्षन्तव्यमतन्द्रितैः।
en: You sinless ones, I have also served you. Whether those services have come up to the ideal or fallen short of it, you should forgive me, for I have attended to my duties carefully.

sa: न हि कालेन कालज्ञः स्पृष्टः शोचितुमर्हसि। कालो लोहितरक्ताक्षः कृष्णो दण्डी सनातनः॥
en: You are fully acquainted with the power of Time. Afflicted by time you should not grieve. Know that Krishna Himself otherwise called Hari, is that Time with bloodred eyes and with club in hand.

sa: व्यासस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदस्य च धीमतः। स्वयं चैव महाराज कृष्णस्याहतामस्य वै॥
en: Having heard the words of Vyasa, as also of the highly intelligent Narada, I have described to you the adorableness of Krishna. I have myself added, from my own knowledge, something to that account.

sa: तेन त्वं ब्रह्मभूयत्वमवाप्स्यसि धनानि च। आत्मनश्च परेषां च वृत्तिं संरक्ष भारत॥
en: By such conduct you are sure to acquire immense riches, and become a Brahman (in your next life). Do you, O Bharata, protect your own means as also the means of others people's livelihood.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः स पृथिवीपालः पाण्डवानां धुरंधरः। निर्ययौ सहसोदर्यः सदारश्च नरर्षभः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then that lord of Earth, that foremost of men, that upholder of the burthens of the Pandavas, wen tout, accompanied by all his brother as well as the ladies of his household.

sa: इयं स्वसा राजचमूपतेश्च प्रवृद्धनीलोत्पलदामवर्णा। पस्पर्ध कृष्णेन सदा नृपो यो वृकोदरस्यैष परिग्रहाय्यः॥
en: This one, whose complexion is like an assemblage of blue lotuses, is the sister of that monarch, that lord of hosts, who used to always challenge Krishna. She is the foremost wife of Vrikodara.

sa: किं तु मद्वचनाद् ब्रूहि राजानं भरतर्षभ। यद् यदिच्छसि यावच्च गृह्यतां मद्गृहादिति॥
en: Do you, however, instructed by me, say to the king, O foremost one of Bharata's family, that he may take from my house whatever articles he wishes and in whatever measure also he likes.

sa: वायसः शतवर्षाणि ततो जायति कुक्कुटः। जायते व्यालकश्चापि मासं तस्मात् तु मानुषः॥
en: Living as a crow for a hundred years, he next assumes the forin of a cock. His next change is that of a snake for a month. After this he regains the human form.

sa: सोम उवाच ब्राह्मणास्तपसा सर्वे सिध्यन्ते वाग्बलाः सदा। भुजबीर्याश्च राजानो वागस्त्राश्च द्विजातयः॥
en: Soma said The Brahmanas become crowned with success by virtue of their penances. Their strength consists in speech. The power of Kshatriyas is in their arms. The Brahmanas, however, have words for their weapons.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तया सक्तून् प्रगृह्येदं वचोऽब्रवीत्॥ द्विज सक्तूनिमान भूयः प्रतिगृह्णीष्व सत्तम।
en: Thus addressed by her, he took her share of the powdered barley and addressing his guest, said, 'O twice-bom one, O best of men, do you accept this quantity of powdered barley as well.

sa: आस्तीक उवाच ऋषिद्वैपायनो यत्र पुराणस्तपो निधिः। यज्ञे कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ तस्य लोकावुभौ जितौ॥
en: Astika said The performer of that sacrifice in which the ancient Rishi, Dvaipayana Vyasa, that vast receptacle of penances is present, is sure O foremost one of Kuru's race, to conquer both the worlds.

sa: ततोऽन्नं जायते विप्र मनुष्याणां सुखावहम्। अन्नं प्राणा इति यथा वेदेषु परिपठ्यते॥
en: It is through this, O twiceborn one, that the food of human beings springs up, food that is so agreeable to them! The Vedas say that it is food that forms the vital airs.

sa: असुरैर्निर्जिता देवा निरुत्साहश्च ते कृताः। यज्ञाश्चैषां हताः सर्वे पितॄणां च स्वधास्तथा॥
en: Once on a time, the gods were defeated by the Asuras upon which they became very dispirited. The sacrifices of the deities were all robbed, and the Svadha of the manes was also misappropriated.

sa: अन्नदानां हि ये लोकास्तांस्त्वं शृणु जनाधिप। भवनानि प्रकाशन्ते दिवि तेषां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Hear me, O king, as I tell you what the regions are reserved for those who make gifts of food. The mansions of those great persons shine with resplendence in the regions of Heaven.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ब्रुवाणं कौन्तेयं धर्मज्ञं धर्मतत्त्ववित्। धर्मपुत्रमिदं वाक्यं भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Kunti's son begotten by the deity of Dharma, who was conversant with every duty and who said so to him, Shantanu's son, Bhishma, who knew every duty, answered in the following words.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तृतीयं गुणमुत्तमम्। सर्वभूतहितं लोके सतां धर्ममनिन्दितम्॥
en: Brahman said I shall, after this, describe to you that excellent quality which is the third. It is beneficial to all creatures in the world, and unblamable, and forms the conduct of the good.

sa: अस्य चाधोऽथान्तरिक्षं दिवं च दिशश्चतस्रो विदिशश्चतस्रः। सृष्टिस्तथैवेयमनुप्रसूता स निर्ममे विश्वमिदं पुराणम्॥
en: Below Him are the sky, Heaven, the four cardinal points, and ihe four subsidiary points. It is from Him that the entirc crcation has emanated. It is He who has created this ancient universe.

sa: कुलोद्योतो विशुद्धात्मा प्रकाशत्वं च गच्छति। ज्योतिषां चैव सालोक्यं दीपदाता नरः सदा॥
en: The man who gives lights always illumines his race, acquires purity of soul and effulgence of form. Indeed, such a man, after death, lives in the company of the luminous bodies in the sky.

sa: कस्माच्च पावनं श्रेष्ठं भूमेर्गोभ्यश्च काञ्चनम्। परमं दक्षिणार्थे च तद् ब्रवीहि पितामह॥
en: Why also is gold considered as a purifier superior to earth itself and kine? Why, indeed, is it considered so superior as a sacrificial present? Do you, O grandfather, describe to me all this.

sa: लघुसत्त्वतया ते हि नष्टसंज्ञा भयार्दिताः। नेह युद्धं समर्थाः स्म इत्युक्त्वा प्रययुर्दिशः॥
en: In vonsequence of their being comparatively inferior in point of strength they were deprived of their senses, and afficted with fear; and saying, 'Here we are not equal to fighting' they went their way.

sa: निशम्य बलमुद्विग्नमङ्गदो राक्षसार्दितम्॥ वेगं चक्रे महावेगः समुद्र इव पर्वसु। आयसं परिघं गृह्य सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभम्॥ समरे वानरश्रेष्ठो महापाचे न्यपातयत्। तेन प्रहारेण महापाझे विचेतनः। ससूतस्यन्दनात्तस्माद्विसंजश्चापतद्भुवि।७।।
en: Hearing of the anxiety of his own army thus assailed by the Raksasa, angada, gifted with great vehemence, taking his parigha made of iron and resembling the rays of the sun, dashed on like the rising deep during the lunar half of a month. And that foremost of monkeys encountered Mahāpārsva, who thus struck by the monkeys became insensible with his charioteer and fell down on the earth.

sa: दुमशक्तिगदाप्रासैः शिलापरिघतोमरैः॥ राक्षसा हरयस्तूर्णं जघ्नुरन्योन्यमोजसा। बाहुभिः परिघाकारैर्युध्यन्तः पर्वतोपमान्॥ हरयो भीमकर्माणो राक्षसाञ्जघ्नुराहवे।
en: Rākşasas and monkeys fast slew each other vigorously with trees and darts, maces and prasas, rocks, bludgeons and Tomaras, and by means of their arms resembling bludgeons, coped with their adversaries appearing like hills.

sa: सलक्ष्मणं राघवमाजिमर्दनं दिशागजं मत्तमिव व्यवस्थितम्। सहेत को वानरमुख्य संयुगे युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमं शरार्चिषम्॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, who can withstand Rāghava in a conflict, followed by Lakşmaņa moving like infuriated an elephant and showering shafts like to the rays of the sun at the time of Dissolution?

sa: सुवर्णनानामणिभूषणानां सुवाससां संसदि राक्षसानाम्। तेषां परार्ध्यागुरुचन्दनानां स्रजां च गन्धाः प्रववुः समन्तात्॥
en: From all sides in the court there began to spread the odour of excellent agura and sandal and wreaths belonging to the Räkşasas, decked in gold and various gems, and clad in costly attires.

sa: न धर्मवादे न च लोकवृत्ते न शास्त्रबुद्धिग्रहणेषु वापि। स्त्वं ह्युत्तमः सर्वसुरासुराणाम्॥
en: Neither in religious discussion, nor in social concernis, nor in appropriating the right sense of the scriptures, is there any that can approach you, O hero-Verily you are the foremost among celestials and Asuras.

sa: मृत्युदण्डमहाग्राहं शाल्मलीदुममण्डितम्। कालपाशमहावीचिं यमकिंकरपन्नगम ॥ महाज्वरेण दुर्धर्षं यमलोकमहार्णवम्। अवगाह्य त्वया राजन्यमस्य बलसागरम्॥ जयश्च विपुलः प्राप्तो मृत्युश्च प्रतिषेधितः। सुयुद्धेन च ते सर्वे लोकास्तत्र सुतोषिताः॥
en: The dominion of Death is like the mighty main, having his rod for aquatic animals, agonies for the frees that cover its islands, the noose for the billows, his attendants for the serpents and his terrible fever for the dreadful attitude of the deep. And diving into this terrible deep, you did, O king, discomfit Death himself and win glorious victory. And every one was pleased there with your successful fight.

sa: साधु रावण रामेण मां समानय दुःखिताम्। वने वासितया सार्धं करेण्वेव गजाधिपम्॥
en: to May good betide you, O Rāvaņa. Do you take me to Rāma, stricken with grief as I am, like to a she-elephant anxiously waiting in the forest brought to the lord of elephants.

sa: विभीषणसहायेन रामेण हरिभिः सह । निहतो रावणो देवी लक्ष्मणेन च वीर्यवान्॥
en: He has accomplished his end subdving his enemies and his enemy is slain. O worshipful dame, the powerful Răvaņa has been slain by Rāma, helped by Vibhīşaņa and accompanied by the monkeys and Lakşmaņa.

sa: प्रदोषकाले हनुमांस्तूर्णमुत्पत्य वीर्यवान्। प्रविवेश पुरी रम्यां प्रविभक्तमहापथाम्॥ प्रासादमालाविततां स्तम्भैः काञ्चनसंनिभैः। शातकुम्भनिभैर्जालैर्गन्धर्वनगरोपमाम्॥
en: At dusk, the powerful Hanumān, springing up, entered the charming city of Lankā with its well divided highways; furnished with rows of edifices having golden pillars, and net-works, resembling the metropolis of the Gandharvas.

sa: महोदरं तं विनिपात्य भूमौ महागिरेः कीर्ममिवैकदेशम्। सूर्यात्मजस्तत्र रराज लक्ष्म्या सूर्यः स्वतेजोभिरिवाप्रधृष्यः॥
en: Slaying and striking down on earth Mahodara like to a portion of a mighty hill severed that son of the Sun appeared resplendent in his own effulgence and became irrepressible like to the Sun.

sa: धर्मप्रधानस्य महारथस्य इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवस्य राज्ञः। पुरोऽस्य देवाश्च तथाविधस्य कृत्येषु शक्तस्य भवन्ति मूढाः॥
en: Even the gods become stolid before the sovereign of the Ikşvāku race, having righteousness for his principle quality, and being a mighty car-warrior and of such a character, and who is competent in action.

sa: वीतहव्यश्च नृपतिः श्रुतो मे विप्रतां गतः। तदेव तावद् गाङ्गेय श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं विभो॥
en: I have also heard that formerly king Vitahavya had succeeded in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana. O powerful one, I wish to hear, O son of Ganga, the story of king Vitahavya's promotion.

sa: चिन्तयंश्च न पश्यामि राजंस्तव सुहृत्तमम्। आभ्यां पुरुषसिंहाभ्यं यो वा स्यात् प्रज्ञयाधिकः॥
en: O king, after (due) reflection I do not find there is any who is a better friend of your than these two best of men (Bhishma and Drona) or who excels them in wisdom.

sa: ममेदं वचनात् तात कृतं ते कर्म दुष्करम्। वृणीष्व कामान्धर्मज्ञ यावतो वाञ्छसे हृदा॥ स वव्रे मातुरुत्थानमस्मृतिं च वधस्य वै। पापेन तेन चास्पर्श भ्रातृणां प्रकृति तथा॥ अप्रतिद्वन्द्वतां युद्धे दीर्घमायुश्च भारत। ददौ च सर्वान् कामांस्ताञ्जमदग्निर्महातपाः॥
en: "O child, O virtuous man, you have performed this difficult task at my bidding. Ask me, I shall grant you whatever you desire in your heart.” There upon he asked that his mother might be restored to life, that he might not be haunted by the remembrance of this cruel deed, that he might not be touched by any sin and that his brothers might be restored to their former state that he might be unrivalled in battle and that he might obtain long life. O descendant of Bharata, the greatly ascetic Jamadagni granted him all that he desired.

sa: शून्यात् तच्च गृहान्मांसं यद्यप्यपहृतं तव। नेच्छते दीयमानं च साधु तावद् विमृश्यताम्॥
en: If meat had really been stolen from your house in your absence, remember the jackal refuses to take any meat that is even given to him. Let sufficient attention be paid to his fact.

sa: सुखः सांग्रामिको मृत्युः क्षत्रधर्मेण युध्यताम्॥ मृतो दुःखं न जानीते प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नुते।
en: Death in the field of battle while fighting according to Kshatriya custom, is welcome. Such death begets no grief. By meeting with such a death, a person enjoys eternal happiness in the other world.

sa: नारायणस्याङ्गतां ज्वलन्ती दृष्ट्वा श्रियं पद्मसमानवर्णाम्। कौतूहलाद् विस्मितचारु नेत्रा पप्रच्छ माता मकरध्वजस्य॥
en: Seeing ihe goddess of Prosperity, shining with beauty and gifted with the hue of the lotus, the mother of Pradyumna having the emblem of Makara on his banner, filled with curiosity, said these words.

sa: ते पूज्यास्ते नमस्कार्या वर्तेथास्तेषु पुत्रवत्। ते हि लोकानिमान् सर्वान् धारयन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: They, indeed, deserve to be adored. They deserve to have our vows. You should bchave towards them as if they are your sons. Indeed, it is those wise men who upholds all the worlds.

sa: देवानामपि ये देवाः कारणं कारणस्य च। प्रमाणस्य प्रमाणं च कस्तानभिभवेद् बुधः॥
en: They are the gods of the gods, and the cause of all causes. They are the authority of all authorities. What man of intelligence and wisdom is there who would seek to humiliate them.

sa: कृतां चेन्मन्यसे रक्षां स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु विशाम्पते। अनुयास्यामि बीभत्सुं करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: May good betide you, O king. If you think that these arrangements will be sufficient to ensure your safety, O ruler of men, then I shall go towards Vibhatsu and carry out your command.

sa: मूतॊ हि जल्पतां पुंसां श्रुत्वा वाचः शुभाशुभाः। अशुभं वाक्यमादत्ते पुरीषमिव सूकरः॥
en: As the swine seeks for the dirt and filth even when it is in a flower-garden, so does a wicked man chose only evil out of the evil and the good that others speak.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षिसदृशो जज्ञे देवैरपि सुदुःसहः। न हन्ता विद्यते चापि राजन् भीष्मस्य कश्चन॥
en: Like a Brahmarshi ( a devotee of the first rank and order) he was born among men and is hard to be vanquished even by the gods. There is no slayer of Bhishma, Oking.

sa: न तेऽपराधमिह वै दृष्टवानस्मि सुव्रत। प्रीतोऽस्मि तव गोविन्द वृणु कामान् यथेप्सितान्।।३८
en: O you of excellent vows, I have not found the slightest fault in you. O Govinda, I have been highly pleased with you. Do you solicit the fruition of such desires as you please.

sa: षोडशानां सहस्राणां वधूनां केशवस्य ह॥ वरिष्ठा च सलोक्या च केशवस्य भविष्यसि।
en: You will become the foremost of all wives, numbering sixteen thousand, of Keshava. At last, when the time comes for your departure from the world, you will acquire the inseparable companionship of Krishna hereafter.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच नात्मानमनुशोचामि नेमान् भ्रातृन् महामुने। हरणं चापि राज्यस्य यथेमां दुपदात्मजाम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O great sage, I do not grieve so much for myself or for these my brothers or for the loss of my kingdom as (I do) for this daughter of Drupada.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा प्रतिवचस्तस्य दत्तं त्वया किल। यत् पुरा तत् पुनस्त्वत्तो वैदर्भी श्रोतुमिच्छति॥
en: Hearing these words (as above), you formerly gave answer to the Brahmanas. As you did before, so do now; for the daughter of the king of the Vidharbhas wishes to hear them in detail.

sa: क्षतत्राता क्षताज्जीवन क्षन्ता स्त्रीष्वपि साधुषु। क्षत्रियः क्षितिमाप्नोति क्षिप्रं धर्मं यशः श्रियः॥
en: Saving others from injuries, defending himself against wounds and injuries and showing forgiveness to women and the pious, a Kshatriya soon obtains the (rule of the) earth, as also religious merit, fame and prosperity.

sa: धर्मे तपसि दाने च विचिकित्सास्य जायते। स कृत्वा पापकान्येव निरयं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Despite the desirability of practising virtue, penances, and gifts, the desire for doing all sorts of forbidden acts originates in his mind. By thus perpetrating various sorts of sinful deeds, he goes to hell.

sa: क्षान्तान् दान्तांस्तथा प्राज्ञान् दीर्घकालं सहोषितान्। त्यजन्ति कृतकृत्या ये ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who renounce persons gifted with forgiveness, selfcontrol and wisdom, or those with whom they have associated for many years when these are no longer of service to them have to sink in hell.

sa: ये न हृष्यन्ति लाभेषु नालाभेषु व्यथन्ति च। निर्ममा निरहंकाराः सत्त्वस्थाः समदर्शिनः॥
en: They are never overjoyed at any acquisition or pained at any loss. Without being attached to anything, and shorn of pride, they are devoted to the quality of Goodness, and they regard all impartially.

sa: इत्येतैः कर्मभिर्व्यस्ता द्विजा वर्णान्तरं गताः। धर्मो यज्ञक्रिया तेषां नित्यं न प्रतिषिध्यते॥
en: Divided by these occupations, Brahınanas, falling away from their own order became members of the other three castes. All the four castes, therefore, have always the right to perform all pious rites and sacrifices.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं तदक्षरमित्युक्तं यस्मानावर्तते पुनः। किं च तत्क्षरमित्युक्तं यस्मादावर्तते पुनः॥
en: What is that which is called Undecaying and by acquiring which no one has to return? What, again, is that which is called Decaying, and by acquiring which one has to return once more?

sa: ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि स्तोभाश्च विधिचोदिताः। यस्मिन्नेतानि सर्वाणि भवन्तीह स वै द्विजः॥
en: He, indeed, is a Brahmana in whom are the Riches, the Yajushes, the Samans, and the explctives necessary for completing the rhythm of the Samans according to the rules laid down in Vedic grammars.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दुष्प्रज्ञानेन निरया बहवः समुदाहृताः। प्रशस्तं जापकत्वं च दोषाश्चैते तदात्मकाः॥
en: Reciters, for want of true knowledge and wisdom, go to various descriptions of hell. The discipline followed by Reciters is surely very superior. These, however, that I have spoken o! are their weak points.

sa: चतुष्पात् सकलो धर्मो भविष्यत्यत्र वै सुराः। ततस्त्रतायुगं नाम त्रयी यत्र भविष्यति॥
en: In this age, ye celestials, virtue will flourish in full. After this age will come the cycle called Treta. The Vedas, in that cycle, will lose one quarter. Only three of them will exist.

sa: न खल्वप्यरसज्ञस्य कामः क्वचन जायते। संस्पर्शाद् दर्शनाद् वापि श्रवणाद् वापि जायते।॥
en: One who has not experienced the enjoyment of a certain object, never feels a desire for that object. Desires originate from the actual experience of the pleasures that touch, or sight, or hearing gives.

sa: विष्णोश्चक्रं च तद् घोरं वज्रमाखण्डलस्य च। शीर्णं पुराऽभवत् तात ग्रहस्याङ्गेषु केशव॥
en: The terrible discus of Vishnu and the thunderbolt of Indra were both unable to make the least impression, O Keshava, in days of yore, upon the body of that great source of universal misery.

sa: एवं सर्वेषु कार्येषु विमृश्य पुरुषस्ततः। चिरेण निश्चयं कृत्वा चिरं न परितप्यते॥
en: In all deeds a man should, in this wise, think for a long time and then settle what he should do. By acting thus one is sure to avoid grief for a long time.

sa: पुरुषत्वे सुता यूयं स्त्रीत्वे चेमे शतं सुताः। एकत्र भुज्यतां राज्यं भ्रातृभावेन पुत्रकाः॥ सहिता भ्रातरस्तेऽथ राज्यं बुभुजिरे तदा। तान् दृष्ट्वा भ्रातृभावेन भुञ्जानान् राज्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: Thus commanded by their parent, all the brothers, in a body, began to enjoy the kingdom as their joint property. Seeing those children of the king all jointly enjoying the kingdom as brothers born of the same parents, the king of the gods, filled with anger, began to reflect, by transforming this royal sage into a woman, I have, it appears, done him good instead of an injury:

sa: यद्यप्यस्य महीं दद्याद् रत्नपूर्णामिमां नरः। इदमेव ततः श्रेय इति मन्येत तत्त्ववित्॥
en: If any person gives away the entire Earth with all her treasures, to one conversant with truth, the latter should still consider the gifts of This knowledge as very much superior to that gift.

sa: तस्य मे प्रश्नमुत्पन्नं छिन्धि त्वमनिलाशन। पश्चात् कार्यं वदिष्यामि श्रोतुमर्हति तद् भवान्॥
en: O you who subsist on air only, do you first answer a question that I wish to put to you! Afterwards I shall inform you of the object with which I have come here.

sa: श्राद्धापवर्गे विप्रस्य स्वधा वै मुदिता भवेत्। क्षत्रियस्यापि यो ब्रूयात् प्रीयन्तां पितरस्त्विति॥
en: Upon the termination of a Shraddha performed by a Brahmana the word Svadha should be uttered. If performed by a Kshatriya the words that should be uttered are Let your departed manes be pleased.

sa: लोकतत्त्वं च कात्स्येंन भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। सर्गश्च निधनं चैव कुत एतत् प्रवर्तते॥
en: I wish also to know fully the truth about the genesis and the conduct of the world; the you. coming of creatures into the world and their exit. Indeed; whence their creation and destruction?

sa: व्याजेन चरते धर्ममर्थ व्याजेन रोचते। व्याजेन सिद्ध्यमानेषु धनेषु कुरुनन्दन॥ तत्रैव कुरुते बुद्धिं ततः पापं चिकीर्षति। सुहृद्भिर्वार्यमाणोऽपि पण्डितैश्चापि भारत॥ उत्तरं न्याससम्बद्धं ब्रवीति विधिचोदितम्।
en: Indeed, with hypocrisy one then tries to acquire virture and with hypocrisy one likes to acquire riches. When one succeeds, O son of Kuru's family, in acquiring riches with hypocrisy, one gives his heart to such acquisition wholly. It is then that a person begins to do sinful acts, despite the admonitions of well-wishers and the wise, to all whom he makes reasonable conformable to the scriptural injunctions.

sa: भीष्म उवाच आत्मनानर्थयुक्तेन पापे निविशते मनः। स्वकर्मकलुषं कृत्वा कृच्छ्रे लोके विधीयते॥
en: Bhishma said 'If the mind is stricken with desire, anger and other evil passions, it then inclines towards sin. If one's acts are sullied by sin, he is obliged to dwell in painful regions.

sa: तस्य वाक्यस्य निधने पार्थ जातो हं मृगः। ततो मां शरणं प्राप्तं प्राह योगी महेश्वरः॥ अजरचामरश्चैव भविता दुःखवर्जितः। साम्यं ममास्तु ते सौख्यं युवयोर्वर्धतां क्रतुः॥
en: As soon as he had said these words, O son of Pritha, I immediately became changed into a deer. I then sought the protection of Maheshvara. The great god said to me You will be freed from disease of every sort, and besides immortality shall be yo urs. You will never suffer from grief. Your friendship with Indra shall remain unchanged and left the sacrifices of both Indra and yourself multiply.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स्थानमुत्तममासाद्य भगवन्तं स्थिरव्रताः। आजन्ममरणं वा ते स्मरन्त्युत न वानघ॥
en: Yudhishthira said O pure one, have those persons of firm Vows, after they have acquired that excellent position which is fraught with power and happiness, and recollection of their lives including birth and death?

sa: बुद्धिकर्मेन्द्रियाणां हि प्रमत्तो यो न बुद्ध्यते। शुभाशुभे प्रसक्तात्मा प्राप्नोति सुमहद् भयम्॥
en: Careless in about one's senses of knowledge and of action, one who is not conscious of his wicked deeds, and whose heart is attached to both good and bad, becomes afflicted with great fear.

sa: सा त्वं जातिं श्रुतं वृत्तं भावं प्रकृतिमात्मनः। कृत्यमागमने चैव वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः॥
en: You should, therefore, inform me of the order to which you belong by birth, of your learning and conduct and disposition and nature, as also of the object with which you have come here.

sa: शुभाशुभे पुरा कृते प्रमादकर्मविप्लुते। स्मरन् पुरा न तप्यसे निधत्स्व केवलं निधिम्॥
en: Do you try to attain that one only treasure so that you may not have to grieve at the recollection of your pristine deeds good and bad all of which are marked by mistake.

sa: आत्मकेवलतां प्राप्तस्तत्र गत्वा न शोचति। ईदृशं परमं स्थानं निरयास्ते च तादृशाः॥
en: That Reciter who becomes identified with his Soul (by withdrawing everything into it) goes there. He has, after this, never to experience any sorrow. This region is called Supreme. The other regions are hell.

sa: विषयेषु तु संसर्गाच्छाश्वतस्य तु संश्रयात्। मनसा चान्यथा काङ्क्षन् परं 7 प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: On account of attachment to earthly objects, which has a tendency, to multiply itself, one wishes for things other than those for which one should wish, and accordingly fails to attain to the Supreme.

sa: न कर्मणा पितुः पुत्रः पिता वा पुत्रकर्मणा। मार्गेणान्येन गच्छन्ति वद्धाः सुकृतदुष्कृतैः॥
en: The son is not fettered by the acts of the father, or the father by those of the son. Fettered by their own acts good and bad, all have to wend this common road.

sa: विपन्ना धारणास्तात नयन्ति न शुभां गतिम्। नेतृहीना यथा नावः पुरुषानर्णवे नृप॥
en: When Yoga-contemplation is disturbed or. otherwise obstructed, it can never take the Yogin to an auspicious and even as a vessel which is without a captain cannot take the passengers to the other shore.

sa: येन सर्वमिदं बुद्धं प्रकृतिर्विकृतिश्च या। गतिज्ञः सर्वभूतानां तं देवा ब्राह्मणं विदुः॥
en: That man who properly understands all this as it really is and its various metamorphoses, and who knows what the end is of all created objects, is known by the gods as a Brahmana.

sa: ते वध्यामानाः समरे तव पौत्रेव धन्विना। व्यद्रवन्त दिशस्तूर्णं दावदग्धा इव द्विपाः॥
en: Those warriors, having been slain by that bowman, your grandson, in the field of battle, most speedily ran away in all directions; even, the elephants, burnt by the forestconflagration, (run away from the forest).

sa: तव कोपाग्निना दग्धः पापो राजा जयद्रथः। उत्तीर्णं चापि सुमहद् धार्तराष्ट्रबलं रणे॥
en: O king! The evildoer king Jayadratha was burnt into ashes in the fire of your fury and it was your grace that enabled us to suppress the huge army of Duryodhana in the battle-field.
